name: Heures d'Absence
title: Heures d'Absence
description:
Heures d'Absence is an invitation to let yourself go and enjoy those moments when time suspends its flight. An enchanting break we would love to last forever. A moment the Master Perfumer Jacques Cavallier Belletrud has captured in a profusion of fresh flowers. An absolutely contemporary bouquet giving pride of place to the delicate flowers of Grasse where jasmin and rose de Mai reveal themselves in all their majesty, enhanced by the green and powdery facets of mimosa from Tanneron. A hint of sandalwood and musk prolong the powdery accents of the flowers, while caressing them with a touch of sensuality. A vibrant and luminous fragrance, full of optimism.

The bottle is refillable in stores equipped with a perfume fountain.

  • Jasmine from Grasse

  • Centifolia Rose from Grasse

name: Afternoon Swim
title: Afternoon Swim
description:
A plunge into an ocean of sensations. Feeling all the energy of the waves washing over the skin on a hot summer’s day. Master Perfumer Jacques Cavallier Belletrud pays homage to the citruses he particularly loves. He ennobles a rare Sicilian orange lush with juice, like an explosion of vitamins. A sensation of immense freshness imbues this perfume in which bergamot drifts toward a wave of delights, set against a deep current of mandarin.
To complement the light within the Cologne Perfumes, Maison Louis Vuitton asked the Californian artist Alex Israel to surround them with creative radiance. He envisioned a joyful design with pop colors that celebrate this summer without end.

The bottle is refillable in stores equipped with a perfume fountain.

Le Jour Se Lève is an optimistic and stimulating breath of early morning air. An invitation to set off for new horizons.

name: Fantasmagory
title: Fantasmagory
description:
Inspired by a world of illusions, Fantasmagory is born of the symbiosis of movement and light. Sophisticated yet gourmand, vanilla inspired a new feat of prowess by Master Perfumer Jacques Cavallier-Belletrud: marrying the richness of an ultra-concentrated vanilla with the fluid aesthetic of the Maison’s Les Extraits Collection. This luminous vanilla radiates, unfurling the most voluptuous, floral, and subtle leathery notes. To reinforce such brilliant force, an almond extract adds indulgent, powdery softness. A note of ginger plays up contrast, bringing this virtuoso creation a dazzling freshness.
Fantasmagory is part of the Louis Vuitton Les Extraits Collection, expressing the encounter of two great creative minds. Through these exceptional, highly concentrated fragrance treasures, Jacques Cavallier Belletrud reinvents the perfume extrait with boldness and fluidity.
Frank Gehry, one of the greatest architects of all time, designs his first perfume bottle. He began with Marc Newson’s original bottle, stretching the lines into curves. From his sculptural flourish emerges a transparent veil that appears to float in the air. The bottle is topped with a precious hand-polished metal cap like the splash of an airy, imaginary flower.

The bottle is refillable in stores equipped with a perfume fountain.

  • Vanilla

  • Ginger​
